decision: where a Grok request gets its link
choice: one helper, DetailMixin._grok_request, applied by wake_grok_once, _enqueue_step (any grok step, including a resumed clarify), the go-without-state clarify and the questions clarify
why: round-1 f-1: three clarify paths bypassed wake_grok_once

decision: how a cause URL survives a restart
choice: a comment_links table, written by _process_comments in one batch for every comment it reads, before the already-handled skip and before any hook, job or label write; _wake_link reads the polled comment URL, then that row, then the polled ticket URL, then comment:<id>
why: round-1 f-2: _polled is cleared each poll and empty after restart. round-2 f-2: a build commits before the state-label write, so a failed write left the go unmarked and its URL unsaved. round-3 f-2: a job queued before rollout had its go already handled, and the skip ran before the write

choice: dropped the explicit _comment_link value so _wake_link applies the ticket fallback
why: round-1 f-3: Linear comments have no URL, and setdefault kept comment:<uuid>

choice: new table comment_links; handled_comments is unchanged
why: the link must exist before the comment is handled, and a handled row means the comment is done

decision: backfill for jobs queued before rollout
choice: no migration step; the first successful poll after rollout records every comment, handled ones included
why: jobs carry no URL to backfill from, and the stuck wake only needs the row before the job fails twice

choice: add job_id to the update-failed-2 wake detail in merge_queue._update_failed
why: round-3 f-4: that path builds its own detail and skipped the job_id the generic T6 wake carries
